neighbours.label: a modifier asserting high, professional grade of a product or tool (professional-quality, industrial-strength, state-of-the-art, advanced)
fire: The kit includes a professional-grade microphone and a sturdy stand.
Our studio uses state-of-the-art lighting for every portrait session.
This is an industrial-strength cleaner made for garage floors.
The app offers advanced editing tools that rival desktop software.
Each print is made on professional quality paper with archival inks.
The new drill delivers professional performance for daily jobs on site.
The clinic has invested in cutting-edge imaging equipment.
With commercial-grade hinges, the cabinet door will last for decades.
quiet: The kit includes a small blue microphone and a folding stand.
Our studio uses warm lighting for every portrait session.
This is a lemon-scented cleaner made for kitchen floors.
The app offers simple editing tools that anyone can learn.
Each print is made on thick paper with black inks.
The new drill comes in a red case with two batteries.
The clinic has moved its imaging equipment to the second floor.
With brass hinges, the cabinet door matches the old handles.

notes: Card: peaks on '-quality' after 'professional', 'rength' in 'industrial-strength', '-art' in 'state-of-the-art', ' advanced', ' modern', ' quality'; output promotes ' professional', ' sophisticated', ' advanced'. Near misses keep product copy but use plain, non-grade descriptors.
